title: Week 27 Quiz — Capitalism, Socialism, Labor, and Reform

questions.prompt: Which term best matches this definition: An economic system based largely on private ownership, markets, wage labor, and investment.
choices: laissez-faire
collective bargaining
socialism
capitalism
questions.explanation: Capitalism is the course term defined as: An economic system based largely on private ownership, markets, wage labor, and investment.

questions.prompt: Which term best matches this definition: The view that government should interfere minimally in economic exchange.
choices: social insurance
capitalism
socialism
laissez-faire
questions.explanation: Laissez-Faire is the course term defined as: The view that government should interfere minimally in economic exchange.

questions.prompt: Which term best matches this definition: A family of ideas favoring social or public control of major productive resources and greater economic equality.
choices: social insurance
socialism
Marxism
capitalism
questions.explanation: Socialism is the course term defined as: A family of ideas favoring social or public control of major productive resources and greater economic equality.

questions.prompt: Which term best matches this definition: A theory emphasizing class conflict, historical change, and collective ownership of production.
choices: socialism
Marxism
collective bargaining
laissez-faire
questions.explanation: Marxism is the course term defined as: A theory emphasizing class conflict, historical change, and collective ownership of production.

questions.prompt: Which term best matches this definition: Negotiation between workers acting together and employers.
choices: Marxism
laissez-faire
social insurance
collective bargaining
questions.explanation: Collective Bargaining is the course term defined as: Negotiation between workers acting together and employers.
